svg.title: Supplied hardware and intranet topology, English labels
svg.desc: English labels over the supplied topology. The intranet and three intranet switches retain all visible branch connections. The left server branch shows Big-data 1?3 and Application server 1?3; the right branch shows Application server 1, Big-data 1?3, and a SAS server. These source labels are separate from the equipment schedule. The upper-left partial cloud is unlabeled in the source. All source watermarks and the original crop are preserved.
